question.text: A museum has two sealed collections of artifacts. Collection $X$ contains $5$ paintings, $4$ sculptures, and $3$ manuscripts. After the $8$ artifacts are selected, one artifact is chosen as the opening display piece and one different artifact is chosen as the closing display piece. These two display pieces must be from different categories. How many possible exhibits can be made?
